_readme: Hand-written copy for the README's upstream tables. Merged/open state, counts and ordering come from GitHub on every run; this file only says how a PR is described. A PR not listed here still appears, captioned with its own title, and the run log names it so a line can be added. PRs sharing a row are listed together; 'minor' PRs are folded into the footnote when merged and left out while open.
